status_note: Independently reconstructed (archive decisions D131 and D132). The registered single scoring pass of ARMS01 attempt 002 was reproduced from separate code: membership and priced subset rebuilt byte-identical, all 40 forecast files plus labels, panel and manifest rehashed identical, every estimate and interval within 3e-18 (registered tolerances 1e-12 and 1e-14), blend weights, fit years and grid losses identical, same gate verdicts.

endpoint.estimand: match-weighted paired log-loss difference, left minus right, on identical matches; negative favours the left
endpoint.note: Brier and winner accuracy are descriptive companions; log loss is the sole gated endpoint.

cohort.definition: all ATP primary targets 2017-2024 of the accepted TIER01 attempt 002 all-target cohort; 380 provisional-identity rows in the saved forecast files are excluded; neutral orientation; retirements retained; walkovers absent

arm0.label: full_tier
arm0.role: incumbent at registration; saved TIER01 attempt 002 selected, calibrated HGB forecasts, no refit

arm1.label: full_tier_entry
arm1.role: full_tier plus nine declared model columns, refit on the unchanged trunk
arm1.any_qualifier_definition: 1 when either side entered as Q, as the registered design text says; the LL signed difference is kept.

arm1_llx.label: full_tier_entry with LL treated as no flag

buildoak.label: BuildOak XGBoost adaptation
buildoak.adaptation: frozen D97 adaptation replayed walk-forward: one fit per 30 December boundary (2016-12-30 for 2017 targets through 2022-12-30 for 2023), fit-boundary Elo reference, D-2 releases, native menu and blend-activation rules evaluated at each boundary; accepted ATP 2024 run reused byte-for-byte
buildoak.native_rows: all 16,291 committed 2017-2023 forecasts native; no reason-coded fallback row; recent-era blend inactive every year

contrast3_blend.form: blend logit = (1 - w) * logit(Alcaraz) + w * logit(BuildOak)
contrast3_blend.rule: per target year, minimise match-weighted log loss over the preceding 3 target years' saved forecasts; ties to the smaller weight; never fitted on the target year

gate1_adopt_covariate_block.rule: match-weighted log-loss difference <= -0.0008 and block-8 95% interval upper bound < 0

gate2_public_claim.rule: block-8 95% interval of best Alcaraz arm minus external excludes zero

gate3_blend_research_artefact.rule: on the primary blend years, block-8 95% intervals of blend minus each component both have upper bound < 0; adoption additionally requires independent reconstruction

uncertainty_method.method: stationary calendar-week bootstrap on one pooled inclusive Monday grid, match-weighted ratio within each draw, percentile interval
uncertainty_method.week_label: ISO week of the panel's tourney_anchor_date (calendar Monday)
uncertainty_method.equal_year_secondary: per-year inclusive Monday grids resampled independently, mean of yearly match-weighted means, percentile interval; a draw with an empty year is skipped and counted
uncertainty_method.conditioning: intervals condition on the saved forecasts and omit refit, selection and source-choice uncertainty

arm1_llx_minus_arm0.label: Arm 1 with LL treated as no flag (declared sensitivity)

arm1_impl_minus_arm0.label: attempt_001 implemented variant: any_qualifier counted Q or LL (deviation from the registered Q-only definition; disclosed)

arm0_minus_buildoak.label: non-selected Alcaraz arm against the external system (sensitivity, not gated)

implemented_variant.label: implemented variant (attempt_001, archive decision D131 as first recorded): any-qualifier flag counts Q or LL, as in the frozen admissibility note and the Arm 1 code; disclosed sensitivity

gate3_blend_research_artefact.rule: on the primary blend years, block-8 95% intervals of blend minus each component both have upper bound < 0; adoption additionally requires independent reconstruction

excl_2022_slams.label: registered sensitivity: all contrasts recomputed without the 245 Wimbledon 2022 and US Open 2022 targets whose source rows carry no entry code

not_in_scoring_output: completed-only matches (registered as descriptive; absent from the attempt_002 scoring output)

arm1_minus_pinnacle_normalised.label: normalised Pinnacle on the priced subset (descriptive)

power.note: registered planning values: contrast 2 effective SD 0.188 (MDE 0.0038, power 0.74 at the 2024 gap); contrast 1 bracketed between effective SD 0.045 and 0.110 (conservative MDE 0.0022). The realised effective SDs are reported so the reader can see which case obtained.

reporting_sentences.rule: registered in experiments/ARMS01.design.md 'Reporting sentences'; X, L, U and k filled from this file at four decimals
reporting_sentences.gate2_supported: Alcaraz scores ahead of every public model we could run, with intervals excluding zero: the BuildOak XGBoost adaptation on 18,972 ATP matches from 2017 to 2024 (paired log loss −0.0070, 95% interval [−0.0100, −0.0040], 7 of 8 years), and the Ultimate Tennis Statistics formula and the Ingram point model on 2,681 ATP matches from 2024. Paired log loss, stationary calendar-week bootstrap.
reporting_sentences.gate1_passed: full_tier_entry: full_tier plus entry status (Q, LL, WC, PR) and tournament-level context; −0.0011 versus full_tier [−0.0018, −0.0004], 6 of 8 years negative.
reporting_sentences.gate3_failed: A past-only logit blend with BuildOak did not beat both components with intervals excluding zero (blend − Alcaraz −0.0009 [−0.0021, +0.0003]; blend − BuildOak −0.0076 [−0.0107, −0.0043]); no blend is released.

wta_secondary: in progress; reported separately under its own gates; never pooled with ATP; no WTA result changes the ATP claim
limitations: exposed retrospective comparison of complete systems with different legitimate histories; not an untouched test, prospective evidence or a market claim
registration not blind to 2024 or to the entry-status signal (22 September review screens); the eight-year frozen design is a mitigation, not a cure
the BuildOak recipe was selected by its author on ROC AUC with sight of 2026 data; full_tier's bundle and calibration were developed on the same 2017-2024 ladder

entry codes are absent at Wimbledon 2022 and the US Open 2022 (245 targets encoded as no flag; registered sensitivity reported); lucky-loser assignment can post-date D-2 (registered LL sensitivity reported)
BuildOak 2017-2023 forecasts are committed and verified but not independently re-run; only 2024 has a byte-for-byte reproduction
intervals condition on saved forecasts; no family-wise adjustment across the three gates (disclosed, not corrected)
no claim beyond the named systems, this cohort and paired log loss
interpretation: Gate 1: adopt full_tier_entry as incumbent. Gate 2: supported. Gate 3: not met; no blend is released. Independently reconstructed (archive decisions D131 and D132).
